name: Dominoes Classic
author: Addicting Games
description: Dominoes Classic is the online version of your favorite board game. There are three modes to play this classic domino game: original, block, and all-fives. With each mode you can adjust the difficulty level which changes how the AI plays. Dominoes is a fun board game that we use to play with friends and family. Sometimes you’re in the mood to be alone or you just want to play a quick game and don’t have anyone around. That’s where this Dominoes Classic game comes in. You can play against the AI in this online version of the classic board game while enjoying your time by yourself. You can shake things up by playing it in different modes and difficulty levels.
